name: QIDI PLA Wood @BBL A1
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 50 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 200 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed raised to 18 mm3/s (printer profile 12) from the manufacturer's 200 mm/s rating.
Product page: nozzle 190-220 C, bed 30-60 C (with glue), speed 40-200 mm/s, density 1.22-1.24 (1.23 used), drying 50 C 4-6 h (alt. 55+/-5 C 8 h), Vicat 58 C, HDT 57 C. Comparison guide: 0.4-0.8 mm any material, bed 45-60 C, 40-80 mm/s, fan 50-100 %, drying 50-55 C 4-6 h, keep sealed with desiccant. Wood powder is mildly abrasive and clogs small nozzles; QIDI lists all nozzle materials, so abrasive=false. Page lists hardened steel first in hotend compatibility. Variants out of stock at retrieval.
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/pla-wood-filament
